description: The latest labor plan Workforce Management reported for a path — a read-only projection, distinct from this service's own Shift Plan.

observedAt.description: When this service last observed a ShiftPlanCommitted event for this path.

driftHeads.description: ADR-0019 reconciliation of this service's own committed PathPlan against Workforce's observed plan: `plannedHeads` here minus our `PathPlan` planned heads — signed, never absolute, and no opinion about which side is right. `0` means the plans agree. **Present only once a comparison has been computed** (both a committed PathPlan and an observed plan exist); omitted, not zeroed, otherwise.

driftDetectedAt.description: When this service detected the drift (the later of the two commits). Present only when `driftHeads` is non-zero.
